summary: Frontend testing for receipt modal feature on PlayStation lounge app. CRITICAL syntax error blocking entire app fixed (missing </SafeAreaView>, ); and } before StatCard in index.tsx). After fix, all 4 requested features verified end-to-end: receipt modal appears after stop session, contains all required fields, close button returns to dashboard with room idle, and cafeteria target-room regression also passes.
action_items: Verify the grand-total math in receipt: in test, play=0.01 د.أ + cafe=1.00 د.أ but total displayed 1.00 د.أ. Likely backend rounding (cafeteria = 0.50+0.50 exact, play very small) — may not be a bug, just truncation. Worth a quick check that backend total_cost = play_cost + cafeteria_cost (rounded the same way).
Optional: console shows transient 'load error Failed to fetch' on first paint — non-blocking (data loads on subsequent fetch).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: index.tsx Dashboard component was missing closing </SafeAreaView>, ) and } between </Modal> (line 547) and 'function StatCard' — caused a hard SyntaxError and rendered the entire app a server-error page. This was a blocker introduced when adding the receipt modal block.
Minor: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents are deprecated in React Native Web — non-breaking warnings only.
seed_data_creation: Started/stopped one test session on Room 1 with 2 cafeteria items (بيبسي, كوكا كولا) — session was paid and closed. No leftover active session from this test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 receipt-modal flows verified: (1) tapping stop-session-btn closes session modal and opens receipt modal; (2) receipt shows green check, تم الدفع بنجاح, room name (غرفة 1), سعر الساعة, start/end times, duration, items list with prices, تكلفة اللعب, تكلفة الكافتيريا, الإجمالي المستحق in green box, شكراً لزيارتكم thanks message, current date; (3) print-receipt-btn and close-receipt-btn render; close-receipt-btn closes the modal and returns to dashboard with Room 1 back to متاحة (idle); (4) cafeteria regression: target-standalone + 5 target-room-* chips render, selecting a room shows 'إضافة لفاتورة: <room name>' header, checkout button text becomes 'أضف للفاتورة'. Note: ~5 other rooms remain active (pre-existing state, not created by this test).
